component.name: Music0
component.summary: Local-first music player with online streaming

description.p: Music0 is a Material 3 Expressive music player built with Compose Multiplatform and a pure-Rust JNI audio core. It combines a local library scanner, synced lyrics, and a native Rust playback engine with fast online streaming, while keeping playlists, likes, and recommendations on your own device.

ul.li: Search and stream online tracks through InnerTube and JioSaavn fast paths with optional yt-dlp fallback.
Loopback range streaming with local caching, batch downloads, and offline Airplane Mode.
Local library management for saved albums, followed artists, Smart Mixes, and custom playlists.
Synced LRCLIB and YouTube Music lyrics in Cinema and Stage modes with shareable lyric cards.
Gapless playback, Autoplay, 10-band biquad DSP equalizer, loudness normalization, and AutoEQ support.
On-device taste recommender powered by audio features, likes, skips, and listening history.

description.p: No account is required and no listening data leaves your machine. Online catalog availability depends on upstream services.
